authorized.description: Register, join, exchange messages, log out, and sign back in to the same history.
Two groups keep the correct members, senders, and message histories.
One of three members leaves; the remaining two can keep chatting.
One of two members leaves; the remaining member can read retained history.
One of three accounts is deleted; the remaining two can chat and read its anonymized messages.
One of two accounts is deleted; the remaining member can read its anonymized messages.

denied.description: A signed-in user guesses another room's ID.
An invited user has not accepted.
An invited user declines instead of joining.
A member leaves, then tries the same room again.
A request has no session cookie.
A request uses an invented session cookie.
A member reuses a session whose expiry has passed.
A member replays the old cookie after logging out.
A deleted account replays its old session cookie.
The creator tries to send before anyone joins.
The remaining member tries to send in an inactive room.
A member supplies another account's sender ID.
